name: typeset
description: Diagram the TypeScript models (interfaces, type aliases, enums) in an Angular feature directory, grouped by directory

scripts.docs:sample:check-drift: node dist/cli.js --repo-root fixtures/feature-app --out-dir dist/sample-check src/app/features/orders && (diff -r docs/sample dist/sample-check || (echo 'docs/sample is stale: run npm run docs:sample:generate and commit the result' >&2 && exit 1))
scripts.verify: npm run build && biome check && npm run check:fallow && npm run test && npm run docs:sample:check-drift
